sentences.text:
Mr. S.K.Shrivastava, learned GA for the r Call for the record of the learned courts below.
Heard on I.A.No. 6037/2021, which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

This revision has been preferred by the petitioner against the order of appellate court, which has sustained the conviction imposed upon him under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced him to suffer R.I. of 1 year and fine of Rs.2000/-, in default of payment of fine, 3 months additional R.I. A n application has been filed for exempting the surrender of the petitioner before this petition is heard.
The petitioner is a CoVID survivor having been infected by the corona virus on 01-04-2021 and the said report is at page No. 7.
Under the circumstances, I deem it fit to exercise my powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C and exempt the petitioner from surrendering and going to prison.

Looking at the facts and circumstances of the case, I.A.No. 6037/2021 is allowed and it is directed that the applicant shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.

The jail authorities shall have the applicant checked by the jail doctor to ensure that he is not suffering from the corona virus and if he is, he shall be 2 CRR-1161-2021 sent to the nearest hospital designated by the State for treatment.
If not, he shall be transported to his place of residence by the jail authorities.
List this case on 16-08-2021 for final disposal at motion hearing stage.
